label: flow
definition: An area of the product, carried by the flow:<flow> label on an issue or an effort. The set is EFFORT_FLOWS in lib/core/effort.sh (Core, UI, API, Docs, Infra, Auth, Data, Web, App), and a project overrides it with effort.flows in its config. A flow says where the work lands, not when it runs.
is_not: A sprint or a wave: those are units of time and of parallel work; a flow is a part of the product and spans many of them.
An effort: an effort is one goal with sub-issues; many efforts share a flow.
A role: role: says who builds it; flow: says which part of the product it changes.
